title: The Fossil Hunter of Lyme Regis
paragraphs: Mary Anning was born in 1799 in Lyme Regis, a small town on the south coast of England. Her family was poor, and her father made furniture and sold fossils to visitors from a table outside their home. As a child, she and her brother found the remains of an ichthyosaur, a large sea reptile that lived millions of years ago. The find attracted the attention of collectors and scholars far beyond her small town.

After her father died, Mary kept searching the cliffs and the beach, often just after a storm. That is still the best time to find fossils on that coast. In 1823 she found the first complete plesiosaur skeleton, which the famous scientist Georges Cuvier at first thought was a fake. She sold her fossils to collectors and scholars, and this trade helped support her family. She also taught herself anatomy and geology, even though she had little formal education.

The Geological Society of London did not accept women as members, so she was never one of them. Scholars studied and wrote about her fossils, but they often did not credit her discoveries. Today, historians recognise her as an important pioneer of palaeontology. Her story shows how class and gender once decided whose work was celebrated.

sources.claim: Mary Anning 1799'da Lyme Regis'te doğdu; ailesi çok yoksuldu; babası marangoz/mobilya ustasıydı (cabinetmaker) ve fosil toplayıp satıyordu.
sources.source: Natural History Museum, London, Mary Anning: unsung hero; https://www.nhm.ac.uk/discover/mary-anning-unsung-hero.html

sources.claim: Anning ailesi buluntularını evlerinin dışındaki bir masadan ziyaretçilere satardı; baba çocuklara fosil bulmayı ve hazırlamayı öğretti.
Erkek kardeşi Joseph dev bir kafatası buldu, Mary iskeletin geri kalanını çıkardı (ihtiyozor); Mary 1823'te ilk eksiksiz plesiyozor iskeletini buldu.
Plesiyozor 10 Aralık 1823'te bulundu; Cuvier başta bunun sahte olduğunu düşündü.
sources.source: Geological Society of London, Plesiosaurus dolichodeirus, found 1823; https://www.geolsoc.org.uk/the-library/online-exhibitions/mary-anning-and-the-geological-society/reconstruction-of-life/plesiosaurus-dolichodeirus/

sources.claim: Fırtınadan hemen sonra fosil aramak Lyme Regis'te hâlâ en iyi zamandır; Anning fırtına sonrası arama yapardı.

sources.claim: Az resmi eğitim almasına rağmen okumayı biliyordu ve jeoloji ile anatomiyi kendi kendine öğrendi; bilim insanları buluntularını satın aldı ama çoğu zaman keşiflerinin hakkını vermedi; Londra Jeoloji Cemiyeti onu kabul etmedi; fosil satışı ailenin borçlarına katkı sağladı; öncü paleontolog.
